summary: Three churches: St. John the Baptist (Walton), St. Peter's (Delhi) and Holy Family (Downsville). The Mass Schedule box and Mass intentions agree in all three bulletins. First-Friday Masses and Holy Hour, first-Saturday Reconciliation and Tuesday Adoration are in the calendar. Open: the hours of Thursday Adoration in the St. John the Baptist chapel, which the bulletins and the website print differently.

slots.rationale: R28, R6: the place is settled (R38): the website calls it the Eucharistic Chapel at St. John the Baptist Church in Walton, a listed church. The hours are not: all three bulletins say 7:00 AM-6:00 PM, but the website says 6:00 AM-6:00 PM on one page and 7:00 AM-7:00 PM on another. Leaning to the bulletins, which agree three weeks running. The website's Thursday 7:00 PM Holy Hour is left out because it is not in the bulletins.
